prompt: Build an SVG flowchart of three boxes joined by arrows that draws itself in — boxes fade up first, then connector lines animate stroke-dashoffset.
heading: UI Components

note: A card or panel that looks like frosted or liquid glass — semi-transparent with a blurred background showing through and a soft edge. Also called a frosted panel.
prompt: Build a frosted-glass card: semi-transparent white, 16px backdrop blur, a soft 1px border, floating over a colorful blurred background.
heading: UI Styles & Surfaces

note: A soft, same-colour look where buttons and cards appear gently pressed into or raised out of the background using subtle inner and outer shadows.
prompt: Build a neumorphic button in the same color as its background, using a soft outer shadow and inner highlight so it looks gently raised, pressing inward on click.
heading: UI Styles & Surfaces

note: A soft halo of light around an element or text, making it look like it's emitting light. Adds a premium, neon, or magical feel.
prompt: Add a soft neon glow to a button using layered box-shadows in the accent color, pulsing the glow radius gently in a 2s loop.
heading: UI Styles & Surfaces

note: A background of several colours blended together in soft, cloud-like blobs — smooth and modern, no hard lines between the hues.
prompt: Build a gradient-mesh background of three soft blurred color blobs (purple, blue, pink) blended smoothly with no hard edges, slowly drifting.
heading: UI Styles & Surfaces

note: A background where one colour fades smoothly into another along a straight line — top to bottom, side to side, or diagonally.
prompt: Build a full-screen linear-gradient background fading from deep indigo at the top to warm pink at the bottom along a diagonal.
heading: UI Styles & Surfaces

note: A background where colour radiates out in circles from a centre point — bright in the middle fading outward (or the reverse). Good for spotlight or glow backdrops.
prompt: Build a radial-gradient background glowing bright teal at the center and fading to near-black at the edges for a spotlight backdrop.
heading: UI Styles & Surfaces

note: Rough, sketchy lines and boxes that look drawn by hand with a marker — the wobbly, casual diagram style made popular by Excalidraw.
prompt: Build a diagram with rough, wobbly hand-drawn box and arrow strokes in the Excalidraw style, slight jitter on the lines, casual marker feel.
heading: UI Styles & Surfaces

note: A small looping element — a spinning arc, ring, or dots — shown while something is loading, so the interface feels alive instead of frozen.
prompt: Build a loading spinner as a single arc rotating 360 degrees in a continuous 1s linear loop, ease none.
heading: UI Components

note: A card that grows open on click to reveal more content, then collapses back. Smoother than jumping to a new screen — the context stays in place.
prompt: Build a card that expands its height to reveal hidden content on click over 0.4s with ease power2.inOut, then collapses back on click.
heading: UI Motion

note: The tiny dip-and-spring a button does when clicked. A classic micro-interaction that makes a control feel physical and responsive.
prompt: Add a micro-interaction where a button dips to scale 0.94 on press and springs back to 1 with ease back.out(3) over 0.2s.
heading: UI Motion

note: A side panel that slides in over a dimmed backdrop to show menus, settings, or details — then slides back out. Common on mobile and dashboards.
prompt: Build a side drawer that slides in from the right over a dimmed backdrop in 0.35s, ease power3.out, and slides back out on close.
heading: UI Motion

note: A moving object stretches and blurs in its direction of travel, the way fast motion smears on camera. Sells speed and weight instead of a stiff, robotic move.
prompt: Animate an element flying across the frame with a directional motion blur that stretches along its travel, selling speed rather than a stiff move.
heading: Animation Concepts

note: A gentle up-and-down drift that keeps elements subtly alive even when nothing is happening — the 'floating UI' look for cards, badges, and 3D objects.
prompt: Animate a card gently bobbing up and down 8px in a 3s loop with ease sine.inOut, yoyo repeat, for a subtle floating idle.
heading: Animation Concepts

note: Each letter animates on its own — moving, scaling, or rotating individually rather than the whole word acting as one block.
prompt: Animate a headline where each letter individually rotates in from 90 degrees and fades up, staggered 40ms apart, ease back.out.
heading: Text Animation

note: Words appear one after another in sequence, building the line as you read it — great for emphasising a message beat by beat.
prompt: Animate a sentence revealing one word at a time, each fading up 12px, staggered 0.18s apart, ease power2.out.
heading: Text Animation

note: Characters animate in with a small delay between each one, so the letters cascade in rather than all landing at once.
prompt: Animate a word's letters cascading in from y:20 and opacity 0, staggered 50ms apart left to right, ease power2.out.
heading: Text Animation

note: One word smoothly transforms into another word or shape, the letters bending and flowing between the two instead of cutting.
prompt: Animate one word morphing into another by interpolating the letter shapes over 0.8s, ease power2.inOut, so the glyphs bend between the two.
heading: Text Animation

note: Text is uncovered through a wipe, clipping mask, or moving shape — the letters seem to slide out from behind an edge.
prompt: Animate a headline sliding up from behind a clipping mask over 0.7s, ease power4.out, so the letters appear to emerge from an edge.
heading: Text Animation

note: Characters appear one at a time as if being typed, often with a blinking cursor — a classic for intros and terminal-style text.
prompt: Build a typewriter effect typing out a line one character at a time at ~45ms each, with a blinking cursor that keeps pulsing at the end.
heading: Text Animation

note: Letters flicker, shift, and distort with digital-glitch artefacts — RGB split, jitter, and static — for a broken-signal, cyber look.
prompt: Animate a heading with a glitch effect: rapid RGB channel split, horizontal jitter, and flickering static bursts for a broken-signal cyber look.
heading: Text Animation

note: A springy move that overshoots its target and wobbles back into place, giving elements a playful, rubbery feel. For the exact GSAP easings, see 'elastic ease' and 'bounce ease'.
prompt: Animate an element into place with an elastic overshoot that wobbles and settles, ease elastic.out(1, 0.4) over 1s, for a playful rubbery feel.
